title: City of Cape Town H3 resolution-8 hex polygon GeoJSON Feature
description: Expected schema for a single GeoJSON Feature extracted from city-hex-polygons-8-10.geojson for resolution 8. Used by src/task1_extraction/run_extraction.py to compute a non-binary schema-conformance score for every extracted record.

index.description: H3 cell index, 15 lower-case hex characters, resolution 8 cells start with '88' and end with 'fffff'.

centroid_lat.description: Loose bounding box around the City of Cape Town's municipal area.

items.description: Linear ring: an H3 hexagon has 6 vertices, closed, i.e. 7 coordinate pairs; pentagons (rare, only at icosahedron vertices) have 6.
